chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fadhdhal, from Ibn Bukayr who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) in the last meeting I had with him about a boy who had not reached puberty who fell upon a woman or committed fornication with a woman — what should be done with both of them? He said: The boy shall be flogged less than the prescribed penalty (hadd), and the full prescribed penalty shall be established upon the woman.

I said: A girl who had not reached puberty was found with a man committing fornication with her. He said: The girl shall be flogged less than the prescribed penalty (hadd), and the full prescribed penalty shall be established upon the man.

key_terms.الحَدّ: Hadd — the divinely prescribed fixed penalty for specific offenses such as zina (fornication/adultery)
key_terms.الحُلُم: Puberty (hulm) — the age of majority in Islamic law, when full legal and religious obligations begin
key_terms.دُونَ الحَدِّ: Less than the hadd — a ta'zir (discretionary) punishment applied to those not fully legally liable

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on a minor who commits fornication with an adult?
ai.summary: Ibn Bukayr narrates a ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) on the legal consequences when a minor (below puberty) engages in illicit sexual acts with an adult. In classical Islamic jurisprudence, the hadd (prescribed corporal punishment) for zina is 100 lashes for unmarried adults or stoning for married ones, but minors lack full legal responsibility (taklif). The Imam's ruling distinguishes between the legally responsible adult — who bears the full hadd — and the minor, who receives a ta'zir (discretionary lesser punishment) as a deterrent. This principle reflects the foundational Shia fiqh maxim that religious obligation is contingent on maturity and mental capacity.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws at the end of having met himasws, about a boy who had not reached (the age of) bed-wetting, fell upon a woman, or was immoral with a woman, which thing should be done with both of them?’ Heasws said: ‘The boy would be whipped less than the Penalty (Hadd), and the (full) Penalty (Hadd) would be established upon the woman’.

I said, ‘A slave girl not having reached puberty was found with a man being immoral with her’. Heasws said: ‘The slave girl would be whipped less than the Penalty (Hadd), and the complete Penalty (Hadd) would be established upon the man’.
